systems.owner: Ministry of Education; its digitisation split between external parties
systems.tiers: data from public, private and religious institutions, reported by education division, district, zone and school; covers primary education only

note: GPE's advisory panel (July 2023) describes the EMIS as data collected in January and published in August as a printed annual statistics report, which is a yearly return and so class census; it adds that the sector review's claim of digitisation could not be checked, that digitisation is planned with partner funding, and that a unique student identity code for tracking through the EMIS was under discussion only. No system of class emis is described, so there is no fact.
